_description: Dashboard filter action: selecting marks in one worksheet filters the other worksheets on the same dashboard.

actions_node._placement: Direct child of <workbook>, after the workbook-level <datasources> and before <worksheets>. One <actions> element holds every action in the workbook.

variant_selected_fields._description: Filter on specific fields instead of every field on the source sheet. Replace the special-fields param with field-captions.

notes.child_order: <activation>, then <source>, then <command>. The schema enforces this order.
notes.action_name: name must be bracketed and unique across the workbook, e.g. [Action1], [Action2]. caption is the label users see.
notes.source: source/@dashboard is the dashboard name and source/@worksheet the sheet users click. Both must exactly match existing names (case-sensitive). Use type='sheet' for a sheet source.
notes.target: param target is the dashboard name. The action then filters every sheet on that dashboard except those listed in exclude.
notes.exclude: Comma-separated worksheet names that the action must not filter. List the source sheet so it doesn't filter itself. Omit the param, or use value='', to filter every sheet on the dashboard.
notes.special_fields_all: special-fields='all' filters on every field of the selected marks. Use field-captions (comma-separated field captions) to filter on named fields only.
notes.auto_clear: auto-clear='true' clears the filter when the selection is cleared.
notes.command_name: tsc:tsl-filter is a filter action. tsc:brush is a highlight action and takes the same params.
notes.verification: This structure validates against the bundled 2026.2 XSD. Clicking marks only proves the action works in a live render, not in a get-view-image PNG.
